phases.name: Precise
phases.gate: Day-ahead error <= 0.010 vs balloons; boom exposure <= 0.5% of flights at the default margin

phases.name: Loudness
phases.gate: Reproduces sBOOM reference cases within 5%; FaINT caustic data within its scatter
